questions.question: You have extensive experience with Selenium, QTP/UFT, and regression testing. How would you design an automated validation strategy for a machine-learning-powered feature whose outputs can vary across model versions?
Describe a defect you uncovered through backend SQL testing that was not visible through the UI. How did you isolate the root cause, document it, and verify the fix?

In your QA roles, you performed load, volume, and stress testing with tools such as LoadRunner. How would you investigate a production performance regression in an ML-backed service under high traffic?
You mentioned helping transition development efforts toward test-driven development. What specifically changed in the team’s workflow, and how did you measure the effect on quality or delivery?
How would you define testable acceptance criteria for a new classifier or recommendation feature when the requirements include both functional behavior and model-quality expectations?
Walk through how you would test the end-to-end integration of a model-serving API: from input validation and response contracts to latency, failure handling, and monitoring.
Describe a time you clarified ambiguous requirements during a product design review or user-story grooming session. What questions did you raise, and what changed as a result?
Your CV lists Java, C#, .NET, SQL, and Unix. Which of these have you used most directly for automation or debugging, and can you describe a technical problem you solved with that stack?
How would you use data from defects, test execution, production logs, and model evaluation metrics to decide whether an already shipped ML feature should be rolled back, tuned, or kept in production?

This role requires technical leadership across engineering teams. Describe an instance where you influenced developers, product stakeholders, or QA peers to adopt a testing practice, process, or quality standard.
